description: M.S.R.P. $1,840,080 - The 2027 Foretravel Realm Presidential takes the luxury motor coach market to all new heights and further propels the legacy of Foretravel. The Foretravel Realm stands alone as the finest motor coach of its kind available on the market today. It rides on Spartan's Premier K4 chassis, that is exclusive to Foretravel, offering incomparable ride, handling, and safety. This extraordinary motor coach is the Luxury Villa Bunk with Spa (LVB) floor plan with the all-new Aristocracy interior décor package that is paired perfectly with the Catapult exterior paint scheme that can only be found on the Realm Presidential Series. Shop a huge selection of luxury diesel pusher motorhomes all at 1 location! Choose from American Coach Eagle – Dream – Entegra Coach Cornerstone – Anthem – Aspire – Fleetwood Palisade – Discovery LXE – Holiday Rambler Armada – Foretravel Realm – Foretravel Realm Presidential and more. We also buy and sell quality pre-owned models such Newmar King Aire – Essex – London Aire – Mountain Aire – Dutch Star - Tiffin Zephyr – Allegro Bus – Phaeton – Prevost Liberty Lady – Millennium - Marathon – Newell and much more. Visit MHSRV.com for our complete line-up and the sale prices that have made us the #1 volume selling motor home dealership in the world 12 years in a row! The LVB floor plan is also unlike that of any other luxury motor coach in the world, offering premier bunk accommodations and 2 full baths. The option that transforms this Realm into a Spa-like retreat is the ultra-high-end massaging tub in the master bath. The Kohler Archer® bath combines BubbleMassage™ and Bask® heated surface to create a soothing spa session. 120 air jets release thousands of heated air bubbles to cushion and massage your body allowing you to massage your back, midsection, and feet as well as control the intensity with 18 different levels. The tub is masterfully tiled and includes a large ledge and a flat-panel TV that is beautifully encased and angled downward for great visibility while using the tub or shower. You will also find a true flat floor design throughout the Realm Presidential Series including, not only Foretravel's premium flat floor slide-out rooms but also the bedroom to master bath transition. The Presidential Series also boasts a 600D Aqua Hot Hydronic Heating system. You will find the premier Valid digital dash with VDC control, along with the Valid air ride suspension, electronic suspension control with self-leveling feature, driver and passenger coach monitors, tire pressure sensors, beautiful full tile floors and back-splashes, ultra-high-end quartz counter tops throughout, premium brand refrigerator and convection microwave, LED accent lighting throughout, a beautiful curved entry way step, Executive entrance steps, a designer entry door with LED accent lighting, 4K QLED TVs where applicable, upgraded cab stereo and sub-woofer, heated and cooled leather pilot and co-pilot seats, recessed and upgraded ceiling features in the galley and bedroom, recessed cook top, an 8-camera system including 6 perimeter 360 Delta Mobile cameras for the ultimate in coach visibility, dual integrated power awnings, power entry door awning, exterior entertainment center, (2) electric sliding cargo trays, exterior freezer, full coach and multi-color LED ground effect lighting package, unmistakable full body paint exterior with Armor-Coat sprayed protection below windshield, chrome grill and accent package, (2) 3000 watt inverters, Gold Heat floor tile heating system, solar panel package, dishwasher drawer, 5.1 surround sound in living room and StarLink antenna. The Spartan K4 chassis is not only massive in stature but boasts a best-in-class Independent Front Suspension system, a passive steering rear tag axle for incomparable handling and maneuverability as well as the Performance Choice® anti-roll bar with selectable drive modes, and automatic traction control. You will know instantly, once behind the wheel of a Realm, that this chassis is truly a cut above all other luxury motor coach chassis. It is powered by a Cummins 605HP diesel. You will also find additional advanced safety features on a Realm like a fire suppression system for the engine, Tyron Bead-Lock wheel safety bands, and steel construction rather than aluminum found in the competition. You will also enjoy the ultimate in slide-out room fit and finish. These slides are undoubtedly head and shoulders above the competition. They feature pneumatic seals that provide a literal airtight seal completely around the entire slide-out room regardless of slide position for the premium in fit, finish, and function. They also feature a power drop-down flooring system that gives the Realm not only a flat-floor when extended, but a true flat-floor when retracted as well. (No uneven floor surfaces, damaging rollers, poorly sealed rubber gaskets, etc.) The Realm also features a flat floor bedroom to master bath transition. You won't find that in the competition; Nor will you find a *3-YEAR or 50K MILE SPARTAN NO-COST MAINTENANCE PLAN INCLUDED - (A Realm Exclusive) and a *2-YEAR or 24K MILE LIMITED WARRANTY. For more details contact Motor Home Specialist today. REALM, by definition, is a royal kingdom; a domain within which anything may occur, prevail, or dominate. The Realm of Dreams is here and available at Motor Home Specialist, the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. Visit MHSRV.com or call 800-335-6054 for complete details, photos, videos, brochures, and more. The Foretravel Realm Presidential Series... Your Kingdom Awaits. 2027 REALM PRESIDENTIAL EXCLUSIVES: • Rear Cap with Stainless Accents and Linier Taillights • Illuminated Logo Badge on Front Cap • Black Octane Wheels with Matching Black Accents • Presidential Badging • LED Lead Rail Light Kits on Driver Side Awning Shells • Paint Graphics Running through Awning Shells and Slide Toppers • LED Accents on Bottom of all Slide Rooms • Ability to Display Cameras on TV’s • Knoedler Air Ride Pilot Seat with Swivel Base, Heat, Cool and Massage Feature (With Haptic Warning System) • Silverleaf Rozie Controller to Check on the Coach While Away • 18 Bottle Wine Chiller (Excludes LV3 FP) • HeadHunter Mach 5 120v Water Pump • Handcrafted Laminate Cabinetry with Presidential Series Designed Interiors • Frameless Residential Shower Door • Infinity Light Box in Ceiling Recess with AC discharge vents • 3-Form Art Inserts on Pocket Doors and Half Bath Door • Ability to Dump Tanks from Inside the Coach • Pneumatic Pocket Doors (Single Door Only) • Kitchen Window Above Countertop • Closet Cabinets Next to Dresser with Four Drawers at Bottom (Floorplan Dependent) • Illuminated Closet Rods • Motorized Luxury King Size Mattress • Aqua Hot Hydronic Heating 600D • Quick Access Interior Load Center • Delta Mobile 360 aiDAIRS Camera System • 10” House Control Panel • Fresco Windows with Motorized Driver Window
